label: Bekasi
short_description: Jakarta's eastern industrial satellite city, home to the Bekasi Industrial Estate and a growing cluster of business hotels along its toll-road corridors.
intro: Bekasi sits directly east of Jakarta and is one of Greater Jakarta's largest industrial and manufacturing hubs, anchored by estates like MM2100 and EJIP that draw a steady stream of corporate and factory-visit travelers. Hotels here cluster around West Bekasi's toll-road interchanges, giving quick access to both the industrial estates and, via three connecting toll roads, central Jakarta itself -- Halim Perdanakusuma Airport is typically a 20-minute drive, with Soekarno-Hatta International further west. Bekasi is administratively and functionally its own city rather than a Jakarta neighborhood, so it's treated as a distinct destination in this directory.
